class K2CaseError(RuntimeError):
    """Sanitized stage failure for the caller's attempt record."""

    def __init__(self, stage: str, category: str, *, duration_ms: float | None = None,
                 stop_campaign: bool = False, status: int | None = None,
                 partial_record: dict[str, Any] | None = None):
        super().__init__(category)
        self.stage = stage
        self.category = category
        self.duration_ms = duration_ms
        self.stop_campaign = stop_campaign
        self.status = status
        self.partial_record = partial_record
